native.scope: native/ only; no authority over the root CLI design system
native.representation: Native APIs and AppKit point units are preserved here because the portable CSS-oriented frontmatter cannot express them faithfully. No HTML/CSS substitutes or synthetic tonal ramps are provided.

colorBindings.purpose: Connection status, activity titles and details, composer hint, launcher detail.
Window, text views, button bezels, segmented control, separator, disabled state, selection, and focus; no custom accent or forced appearance.

layout.resizeBehavior: Capture pre-resize bottom proximity and clip origin; after layout, follow latest or restore origin. Follow-latest resize correction reviewed; deliberate earlier-position retention unverified.
layout.narrowBehavior: Hide navigation during adaptation. Show Agent/Inspect segmented switching when inspection is open. Keep the composer below the active work surface. Widening does not automatically restore navigation.

shapeBindings: NSButton.bezelStyle = .inline for launcher recent workspaces and file entries
native.depth: No custom shadows, gradients, or materials; AppKit window and control depth only.
native.motion: No authored decorative animation or transition tokens.

review.captureContent: Restored actual provider task in the built native window.
review.harness: Actual composer and LUMI bridge; owned-window capture with native chrome; no supplied agent output.
review.dispositionScope: Single resize correction resolved; not an alpha-readiness disposition.

components.name: Native Action Button
components.description: Rounded AppKit buttons for Send/Queue, Stop/Force Stop, inspector controls, navigation actions, and approval decisions. Native control states and typography are inherited.

components.name: Inline Item Button
components.description: Recent workspace and file-list items use inline native buttons. Long paths and filenames truncate in the middle.

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Files / Changes / Sessions actions with SF Symbols, a separator, and a scrollable list. No persistent selected-navigation appearance is implemented.

components.name: Instruction Composer
components.description: Plain NSTextView in a bordered vertical scroll region. Return submits, Shift–Return inserts a line, and marked text prevents submission. Send becomes Queue while work is outstanding.

components.name: Conversation and Activity
components.description: Headerless single-column native table with wrapping titles and selectable plain-text bodies. Activity uses secondary text. Result labels distinguish command evidence from review.

components.name: Read-only Inspector
components.description: Title and Close control above selectable plain monospaced text. Next Page appears for runtime-paginated content and replaces the current page. No editor or styled diff is implemented.

components.name: Compact Surface Switch
components.description: Agent / Inspect segmented control shown below the narrow-window threshold while inspection is open.

components.name: Approval Region
components.description: Approval required heading, scrollable tool/scope/arguments/reason text, and Deny / Allow Once buttons. Hidden unless a run awaits approval.

components.name: Native Dialogs and Menus
components.description: NSOpenPanel selects a workspace. NSAlert handles workspace actions and active-work close/quit decisions. NSMenu supplies the defined application shortcuts.

native.verification: No searchable command palette; keyboard and VoiceOver walkthroughs unverified.

narrative.overview: The native client is a compact macOS operating surface. Familiar window chrome, system typography, semantic colors, and standard AppKit controls establish its character. The composer is the primary working input; conversation, tool activity, and read-only evidence carry the useful content.
keyCharacteristics: System typography and appearance, with restrained emphasis.
An immediately available composer and selectable, read-only inspection.
Plain-text task state, tool activity, and verification labels.
Standard native controls and window behavior.

rules.name: The Semantic Appearance Rule
rules.body: Preserve the native semantic bindings. A light capture does not establish fixed white, gray, or accent tokens. The implementation does not force an appearance; dark appearance remains visually unverified.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Use readable system text for conversation and monospaced system text for inspection. Transcript responses are wrapping plain text; backticks and code fences remain literal characters in the current implementation.

dos: Do preserve AppKit system fonts, semantic color APIs, native controls, and standard window chrome.
Do keep the composer immediately available and file/output inspection selectable and read-only.
Do use the current Files / Changes / Sessions vocabulary and compact native control density.
Do distinguish recorded completion, command evidence, and independent review in task labels.
Do retain the verified resize behavior while treating untested interaction paths as unverified.
donts: Don't replace the native surface with a web shell, landing-page composition, or decorative metrics.
Don't derive fixed colors, synthetic tonal ramps, or a radius scale from AppKit screenshots.
Don't introduce an empty editor as the starting point or imply that read-only inspection edits files.
Don't document a Markdown renderer, searchable command palette, selected sidebar state, or styled diff that the source does not implement.
Don't promote this first integration proof or its scoped resize review into alpha or accessibility readiness.
